title: MERIT x Erdem Eye and Cheek Gift Set
descriptionHtml:
✓ Vegan✓ Clean at Sephora✓ Fragrance Free✓ Cruelty-Free
What it is: A limited-edition set of four essentials for a soft, glowy look inspired by ERDEM’s romantic aesthetic, including two new, exclusive shades.

Ingredient Callouts: Free of parabens, formaldehydes, formaldehyde-releasing agents, phthalates, mineral oil, retinyl palmitate, oxybenzone, coal tar, hydroquinone, sulfates SLS & SLES, triclocarban, triclosan, and contains less than one percent synthetic fragrance. These products are also vegan, gluten-free, and cruelty-free.

What Else You Need to Know: Created in collaboration with ERDEM for the holiday season, this limited-edition gift set pairs MERIT’s bestselling cheek, eye, and lash essentials in soft, wearable shades—all housed in a custom gift box designed w
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
Day Glow:
-Layer on last over cheekbones, brow bones, the tip of your nose, and anywhere else you want a natural, lit-from-within glow.

Flush Balm:
-Swipe onto cheeks or lips.
-Blend in with your fingertips, brush, or sponge.
-Layer for more color payoff.

Solo Shadow Sheen:
-For a sheer wash of color, swipe once across the eyelid or layer for added depth.
-Blend using Brush No. 2 (sold separately) or your finger.
-When finished, screw the cap on tightly to close.

Clean Volume Mascara:
-Comb through lashes from root to tip.
-Build up for more impact.
-To remove, wash with warm water and cleanser.
Ingredients+
Mini Flush Balm:
- Vitamin E: Nourishes and conditions skin.

Octyldodecanol, Hydrogenated Polyisobutene, Hydrogenated Poly(C6-14 Olefin), Synthetic Wax, Silica, Synthetic Fluorphlogopite, Diisostearyl Malate, Polyglyceryl-2 Triisostearate, Sorbitan Isostearate, Ethylene/Propylene Copolymer, Microcrystalline Wax (Cera Microcristallina/Cire microcristalline), Methicone, Aluminum Hydroxide, Isopropyl Titanium Triisostearate, Tocopherol; May Contain/Peut Contenir (+/-): CI 15850 (Red 7 Lake), CI 77491/ CI 77492/ CI 77499 (Iron Oxides), CI 42090 (Blue 1 Lake), CI 77891 (Titanium Dioxide). 26016
